A uniform Mz (Ag z ~ -0.005, F z ~ -0.002, net mz -0.038 mub) and the common orbital Lz (+0.069..+0.070 mub on all four Ag) are symmetry-ALLOWED under m'_x, not symmetry-breaking. why_uniform_Mz_is_allowed.argument: m'_x is antiunitary with spatial part R_x = diag(-1,+1,+1), det(R_x) = -1. For a time-odd axial vector M: m'_x M = det(R_x) R_x (T M) = (-1) R_x (-M) = R_x M = (-Mx, +My, +Mz). Components My, Mz are unchanged between mapped partners; only Mx reverses. Hence common Mz (and layer-staggered My) are invariant under m'_x.
why_uniform_Mz_is_allowed.pair_checks: Ag 1->2: Sx -0.568 -> +0.568 (expected +0.568); Sy +0.019 -> +0.019; Sz -0.005 -> -0.004 (printed residual 0.001). Ag 3->4, F pairs: exact at printed precision.

why_Lz_is_not_orbital_igmc.argument: LORBMOM=.TRUE. reports the orbital angular momentum projected inside PAW augmentation spheres (LORBIT=11). It is not the gauge-covariant orbital magnetization, not the orbital-Zeeman perturbation matrix -B.L, and not an IGMC response coefficient. Site-projected sum_12 Lz = +0.246 mub (Ag-only +0.278) must not be presented as a bulk M_orb or as orbital IGMC.
why_Lz_is_not_orbital_igmc.consequence: the SOC-induced common orbital Lz is a diagnostic hint for the orbital channel, not a computed response
